test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Choose the sentence with no spelling error.**

options.text: They were iresponsible in performing their dutes.
They were irresponcible in perfroming their duties.
They were irresponsible in performing ther dutys.
They were irresponsible in performing their duties.

solution:
The correct sentence is: **They were irresponsible in performing their duties.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 4 **is the correct sentence because it has no spelling errors. All the words are spelled correctly, and the sentence is grammatically correct.
 
• Let's go through the incorrect options and provide the correct spellings and meanings of the misspelled words:
 
 
• They were iresponsible__ in performing their __dutes__.
 
 
 
• Correct spelling:** irresponsible, duties**
 
• **Irresponsible** means** lacking a sense of responsibility or not reliable. **
 
• **Duties **refer to **tasks or responsibilities assigned to someone.**
 __
 
• They were irresponcible__ in __perfroming__ their duties.
 
 
 
• Correct spelling: **irresponsible, performing**
 __
 
• They were irresponsible in performing ther__ __dutys__.
 
 
 
• Correct spelling: **their, duties**
 
• **Their **is a** possessive pronoun** indicating ownership or belonging. 
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and** 3** are incorrect because they contain spelling errors, resulting in incorrect spellings of "irresponsible," "performing," "their," and "duties."
 
• **Option 4** is the correct choice as it has the correct spellings of all the words and forms a grammatically coherent sentence.
